name: Cyber Security
summary: Study programming, data and network security, and security governance in Viborg. This English professional bachelor starts in September 2027 and includes a six-month internship; you may instead exit after two years with an AP degree in Operational Cyber Security.

notes: Governance, Risk & Compliance is pending approval. Specialisation and certification details are due in November; confirm the final curriculum before applying.

description: The first year covers business understanding, programming, computer architecture, communication, automation, data security and network architecture. The second year adds cybersecurity governance, network and communication security, software security and system security. Later study includes specialisation or an international semester, internship, certification and a bachelor project. Governance, Risk & Compliance remains pending approval; Dania promises further specialisation and certification details in November.

structure.teachingStyle: Smaller classes, classroom teaching and group work, with occasional lectures and company visits.
structure.placement: Six-month internship in semester 6, worth 30 ECTS.
structure.studyAbroad: Semester 5 is listed as specialisation or an international semester; detailed choices have not yet been announced.
structure.flexibility: Apply to the bachelor; the first 1½ years are shared with the optional two-year AP exit in Operational Cyber Security. The full bachelor lasts 3¼ years.
specialisations: Details to be announced; no confirmed specialisation choices yet.
